summary: Per-actor post-processing update for a motion subsystem. Lazily initializes two child subsystems (one anchored at this+3272, one at this+3340), advances an internal state machine, clears a one-shot flag, steps a damping value halfway toward its target, selects one of two force-feedback sources based on tire-contact state, solves tire-brush forces, and conditionally applies velocity clamping driven by a global time reference.

local_names.v2: dword-aligned base pointer for the lazy-init subsystems (this + 1764)

operations.description: Take local base pointer v2 = this + 1764 (in bytes) used for both lazy-initialization calls.
LazyInitCallback(this + 1764, this + 3272): ensure the first subsystem is initialized with anchor at this + 3272.
LazyInitCallback(v2, this + 3340): ensure the second subsystem is initialized; the anchor this + 3340 equals v2 advanced by 394 dword elements.
StateTransition(this + 12992, 0): advance the actor state machine with input flag 0.
If the one-shot reset flag at this + 15712 equals 1, it is cleared to 0 so the transition runs once.
Clear the one-shot flag at this + 15712 to 0.
If the damping value at this + 14956 differs from the target damping at this + 14968, interpolate it.
Step the damping value halfway toward its target: this + 14956 = (this + 14968 + this + 14956) * 0.5.
Select the force-feedback source by tire-contact state: non-null contact pointer at this + 3340 with the contact-ready byte at this + 3404 clear takes the active-contact branch.
Copy the selected source into the output value at this + 14960: active-contact source at this + 14976 when contact is present, otherwise the inactive-contact source at this + 14972.
TireBrushModelForceSolver(this, 0): solve tire-brush force contributions for this actor with flag 0.
If the input flag at this + 12988 is zero, enable velocity clamping against the global time reference.
PhysicsForceVelocityClamping(&dbl_7C7428): clamp force-derived velocity using the global race-time value.
Invoked by sub_4B3400 (0x004B3400) as the actor motion post-processing update step.

unresolved: The two fields at this + 14956 / this + 14960 are described as damping and selected force-feedback values from surrounding context; their exact semantics are not established in this function alone.
The contact-state pointer at this + 3340 and the byte at this + 3404 relate to tire contact readiness but their naming is inferred from the branch structure.
The subsystem objects initialized by LazyInitCallback (anchors this + 3272 and this + 3340) are unnamed and their identities are unknown.
